changes.old_rule: NFL Pulse could be recorded as a general supporting signal.
changes.new_rule: When NFL Pulse is materially considered, preserve decision-level Pulse lineage, usefulness grading and one canonical information-event ID for duplicate reports.
changes.reason: Measure whether Pulse improved Mongo decisions without duplicating the Pulse database or treating repeated reporting as independent evidence.
changes.expected_effect: Measure Pulse accuracy, timeliness, decision impact and false alarms while protecting ESPN authority.

changes.old_rule: Pulse was intelligence-only under the general source-authority rule.
changes.new_rule: Pulse remains intelligence-only and can never change Mongo league state without authenticated ESPN confirmation.
changes.reason: Preserve production authority and strict system isolation.
changes.expected_effect: Prevent ownership, roster, FAAB, transaction, IR and lineup contamination.

changes.new_rule: Do not promote a Pulse-derived signal into a permanent Mongo rule from one result; require repeated evidence unless a clear structural failure is discovered.
changes.reason: Avoid overfitting Pulse usefulness to isolated outcomes.
changes.expected_effect: Improve long-run calibration and rule stability.
